from datetime import datetime,timezone
import hashlib,json,math,os,platform,statistics,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/home/phulin/umber4-producer')
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'benchmarks'))
import mvp,producer
from reference import reference
folder=root/'target/producer-handoff'
cpu=min(os.sched_getaffinity(0));os.sched_setaffinity(0,{cpu})
command,env=reference(None,folder/'pdftex')
engines={'umber':([str(folder/'final')],None),'pdftex':(command,env),
         'baseline':([str(root/'target/producer-bench/baseline')],None),
         'previous':([str(folder/'previous')],None),
         'earlier':([str(root/'target/producer-opt/optimized')],None)}
metadata={'date':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'pdftex':subprocess.check_output([command[0],'--version'],env=env).decode().splitlines()[0],
          'rustc':subprocess.check_output(['rustc','--version']).decode().strip(),'rustflags':os.environ.get('RUSTFLAGS',''),
          'machine':platform.platform(),'cpu':cpu,'cpu_model':next(line.split(':',1)[1].strip() for line in Path('/proc/cpuinfo').read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('model name')),
          'binaries':{k:hashlib.sha256(Path(args[0]).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for k,(args,_) in engines.items()},
          'measurement_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(mvp.__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
          'driver_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'driver_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),
          'repeats':9, 'baseline_commit':'29266eb2604f47bb2f6e92df716e76df7b2c3c84',
          'previous_commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD']).decode().strip(),
          'earlier_commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','989b62f']).decode().strip()}
for label,module,cases,size in [('core',mvp,['raw','bodies','integers','groups','source-integers'],2000000),('focused',producer,list(producer.CASES),1000000)]:
    report={**metadata,'generator_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(module.__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'complete':False,'samples':[]}
    startup=folder/f'{label}-startup.tex';startup.write_text(mvp.BOOT+r'\message{UMBER:0,0:END}\end'+'\n')
    report['startup']=mvp.measure(engines,startup,b'0,0',9)
    for case in cases:
        source,expected=module.program(case,size)
        path=folder/f'{case}-{size}.tex';path.write_bytes(source)
        sample={'case':case,'size':size,'bytes':len(source),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest(),**mvp.measure(engines,path,expected,9)}
        sample['cpu_ratio_to_previous']=sample['cpu_median']['umber']/sample['cpu_median']['previous']
        sample['cpu_ratio_to_earlier']=sample['cpu_median']['umber']/sample['cpu_median']['earlier']
        report['samples'].append(sample)
        (folder/f'{label}-confirm.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
        print(f"{case:16} CPU current {sample['cpu_median']['umber']:.6f} baseline {sample['cpu_median']['baseline']:.6f} ({sample['cpu_ratio_to_baseline']:.3f}) previous {sample['cpu_median']['previous']:.6f} ({sample['cpu_ratio_to_previous']:.3f}) earlier {sample['cpu_median']['earlier']:.6f} ({sample['cpu_ratio_to_earlier']:.3f}) pdftex {sample['cpu_median']['pdftex']:.6f}",flush=True)
    report['complete']=True
    report['geomean_baseline']=math.exp(statistics.mean(math.log(r['cpu_ratio_to_baseline']) for r in report['samples']))
    report['geomean_previous']=math.exp(statistics.mean(math.log(r['cpu_ratio_to_previous']) for r in report['samples']))
    (folder/f'{label}-confirm.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
